title: Q-DESIGN-CONSOLE: adopt the language in ultrastable/workers console-ui and the launcher
body:
**Owner:** design-manager
**Trigger:** every tick
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation design --lint
**Status:** open

core/src/console-ui.js, apps/launcher/src/page.js and apps/demos hold their own palettes. Embed the generated --ds-* CSS for ultrastable-console, add a lint of those files to the workers repository checks, and keep the separation guard green.
